title: Structurally Characterized Haloacid Dehalogenase 4A Catalyzes Fluoroacetate Defluorination and Provides a Scaffold for Exploring Organofluorine C horizontal line F Bond Cleavage.
authors: Hu, Miao; Bhardwaj, Shefali; Newton, Sophia; Caputo, Alessandro T; Manefield, Michael J; Scott, Colin
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文表征了HAD 4A酶的结构并验证其催化氟乙酸脱氟，虽以蛋白质结构为核心并涉及对接建模，但方法以实验为主、计算贡献较浅，属于工程化应用而非方法创新。
abstract: Haloacid dehalogenases (HADs) catalyze hydrolytic carbon-halogen bond cleavage and are a tractable enzyme family for studying C horizontal line F bond cleavage. In this study, we characterized HAD 4A from Delftia acidovorans strain D4B. Recombinant 4A was expressed, purified, and crystallized, yielding a 1.59 A apo structure (PDB 9C9E) with an accessible aspartate (Asp22)-centered active site. Under the reported assay condition, purified 4A catalyzed hydrolytic defluorination of fluoroacetate, as supported by enzyme-dependent fluoride release and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry detection of glycolate. The docking model placed the fluoroacetate alpha-carbon near Asp22, providing computational structural context consistent with Asp22 acting as the putative catalytic nucleophile. Compared with related HAD-like dehalogenases, 4A showed a more open active-site entrance, suggesting a possible scaffold for organofluorine accommodation and structure-guided engineering. Exploratory reactions with PFOA (0.5 mM) and high 4A loading (500 microM, 120 h) produced only weak apparent fluoride release (~6 microM). These data do not demonstrate PFOA defluorination but identify 4A as a validated fluoroacetate-active HAD scaffold for future organofluorine biocatalysis.
abstract_zh: 卤代酸脱卤酶（HADs）催化水解性碳-卤键断裂，是研究C—F键断裂的一个易处理的酶家族。在本研究中，我们表征了来自 *Delftia acidovorans* 菌株D4B的HAD 4A。重组4A被表达、纯化并结晶，获得了一个1.59 Å的脱辅基结构（PDB 9C9E），其活性位点以可接近的天冬氨酸（Asp22）为中心。在报告的测定条件下，纯化的4A催化氟乙酸的水解脱氟反应，这通过酶依赖性氟离子释放和液相色谱-质谱检测到乙醇酸得到支持。对接模型将氟乙酸的α-碳置于Asp22附近，提供了与Asp22作为推定催化亲核试剂一致的计算结构背景。与相关的HAD样脱卤酶相比，4A显示出更开放的活性位点入口，提示其可能作为有机氟容纳和结构导向工程的支架。与PFOA（0.5 mM）和高4A负载量（500 μM，120小时）的探索性反应仅产生微弱的表观氟离子释放（约6 μM）。这些数据并未证明PFOA脱氟，但将4A鉴定为一种经验证的氟乙酸活性HAD支架，可用于未来的有机氟生物催化。
